records.title: Inspection violation transfer to Content or Committee, task and violation identity boundaries

sources.locator: RouteAsync: content-only target/status conditions, configured handler resolution and timeline
RouteAsync uses violation id and Inspection.Violation.Route permission

payload.pageMeaning: Inspection violation transfer to Content or Committee, task and violation identity boundaries

facts: Transfer is an action on a violation case. An inspection task and a violation are different entities with different identifiers. A task number is a lookup anchor only; establish the related violation from the authorized task/report or violation sourceTaskId/sourceTaskNo relationship before describing current eligibility.
A task may have no violation, one violation or several. Do not substitute the task numeric id for a violation id, and do not choose one related case without an unambiguous match.
التحويل يخص قضية مخالفة وليس مهمة التفتيش نفسها. يجب التحقق من القضية المرتبطة؛ لا يُستخدم معرّف المهمة مكان معرّف المخالفة.
The inspected RouteAsync supports Content-type violations only. It accepts Content and Committee as route targets; other targets, including Licensing, are not supported by this specific action.

Transfer to Content requires PendingRouting and changes the violation to PendingContentReport. Transfer to Committee requires PendingRouting or PendingReview and changes it to PendingCommitteeDecision. These source-defined conditions do not prove that a named record currently meets them.

The request requires Inspection.Violation.Route permission. The configured Content Team or Committee handler is resolved by the service; a user-supplied department name or role title cannot replace that configuration.
المسار المفحوص يدعم مخالفات المحتوى فقط. التحويل إلى فريق المحتوى يتطلب حالة انتظار التوجيه، وإلى اللجنة يتطلب انتظار التوجيه أو انتظار المراجعة. لا يوجد هدف Licensing في هذا الإجراء المحدد.

For a related, verified violation, open its authorized violation details or list and inspect its available Transfer to Content Team or Transfer to Committee action. Check the target, current state and supporting assessment; record the transfer note where the applicable form supports it. The server records the transition and target handler in the violation timeline.

The inspected list and detail handlers can submit a transfer directly; this source does not prove that the portal presents a separate preview/confirmation modal. An assistant must therefore remain explanation-only: do not invoke the write, imply confirmation occurred or claim the transfer completed. A future write capability would need a verified preview and explicit confirmation before invoking an authorized action.

If the request says Licensing or Content without selecting one, preserve that unresolved choice and explain the supported Content-case conditions. Ask for the relevant violation reference/target when needed; do not silently choose a department or imply a general task-transfer workflow exists.

constraints: These are source-defined conditions, not current-record eligibility or a permission grant. Verify current authorized record, available actions and applicable deployment before a business decision.
No write is executed by reading or explaining these documents. Do not invent missing operations, formal policy owners or approval rules.
